memberdef.name: parseInstruction

briefdescription.para: Parse an instruction mnemonic followed by its operands.
Allow a target to add special case operand matching for things that tblgen doesn't/can't handle effectively.

detaileddescription.para: For example, literal immediates on ARM. TableGen expects a token operand, but the parser will recognize them as immediates.

briefdescription.para: tryParseRegister - parse one register if possible

detaileddescription.para: Check whether a register specification can be parsed at the current location, without failing the entire parse if it can't. Must not consume tokens if the parse fails.

@l/@ha modifier from expression. Recursively scan the expression and check for VK_PPC_LO/HI/HA symbol variants. If all symbols with modifier use the same variant, return the corresponding PPCMCExpr::VariantKind, and a modified expression using the default symbol variant. Otherwise, return NULL.

briefdescription.para: Find all VK_TLSGD/VK_TLSLD symbol references in expression and replace them by VK_PPC_TLSGD/VK_PPC_TLSLD.

detaileddescription.para: This is necessary to avoid having GLOBAL_OFFSET_TABLE created via ELFObjectWriter::RelocNeedsGOT. FIXME: This is a hack.

briefdescription.para: This differs from the default "parseExpression" in that it handles modifiers.
This handles registers in the form 'NN', 'rNN' for ELF platforms and rNN for MachO.

memberdef.name: matchAndEmitInstruction

briefdescription.para: Recognize a series of operands of a parsed instruction as an actual MCInst and emit it to the specified MCStreamer.

detaileddescription.para: This returns false on success and returns true on failure to match.
On failure, the target parser is responsible for emitting a diagnostic explaining the match failure.
